notes:
Snapshot: Mid-market e-commerce SaaS (product search) evaluating Redwood Hosted API for fast iteration; likely move to Dedicated for production throughput and data isolation. Primary technical ask is a reranking endpoint that supports offline scoring and batch candidate uploads.

Timeline / Activities:
- 2026-01-12: Intro call (AE Maya) — high level product fit, metrics.
- 2026-01-20: Technical deep-dive with SE (Owen) — discussed rerank API, candidate formats, expected qps.
- 2026-01-28: Shared eval checklist + security gate.
- 2026-02-02: Live demo of Hosted API rerank prototype (Fireflies FF-20260202-CRM-5582).
- 2026-02-08: Pricing sync; asked for Dedicated 3-node pool cost + SLA.

Use-case & Requirements (customer-provided):
- Workload: hybrid offline + online reranking flow. Candidates generated by existing retrieval layer (Elasticsearch); want Redwood to score/top-N reorder and surface reasons.
- Eval targets: improve NDCG@10 by 6-10% vs current logistic regressor; track MRR, NDCG, click-through lift in test set.
- Latency: offline scoring can be batch; online rerank p95 target 150-250ms (tail matter for UX).
- Throughput: peak ~300 qps for search front-end, avg ~60 qps.
- Cost sensitivity: medium — willing to pay for predictable Dedicated pricing if unit economics are stable.
- Model preference: open checkpoints compatible with Llama-family; interested in quantized variants for cost. Need offline scoring SDK or CLI support for large eval sets.
- Routing: want fallback to smaller/cheaper model on capacity constraints; also per-tenant model pinning for AB tests.

POC Plan (agreed):
1) 2-week POC on Hosted API: upload 50k eval pairs, run offline scoring to compare baselines, provide NDCG/MRR report.
2) End-to-end online demo: integrate rerank endpoint into staging search (small traffic) to validate latency and UX.
3) If POC metrics hit thresholds, present Dedicated pricing + SLA for 3-node reserved pool (expected prod start Q2).

Decision Criteria:
- Measured NDCG@10 uplift >= 6% on labeled eval set.
- Online p95 latency <= 250ms at staging traffic.
- Reasonable Dedicated pricing (est. ARR fits $120k-$300k band).
- Security paperwork: SOC2 + KMS + residency confirmation.

Quotes / Customer voice:
- "We need an offline scorer we can run nightly and an online reranker that's predictable — no surprises on cost."
- "If we can get dedicated throughput and good observability (per-route costs) we can consolidate on Redwood."

Risks / Blockers:
- Legal needs explicit data residency guarantee for EU customers; need Private/Regional assurance or contract clause.
- Security team requires ISO27001 in addition to SOC2 — currently pending.
- Budget committee reviews Dedicated commit (decision expected by 2026-04).

Artifacts / Links:

- Pricing draft v3: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1pricing-dedicated-cobalt-v3
